data.one_liner: Wrapper for Apple's HealthKit and Google's Health Connect.
data.what_it_does: Enables reading and writing health and fitness data from and to Apple Health on iOS and Google Health Connect on Android. Handles permissions, data types, workouts, and routes.
use_when: You need to read or write fitness and health data in a Flutter app
You need integration with Apple HealthKit or Google Health Connect
avoid_when: You need support for the deprecated Google Fit API
strengths: Supports both Apple Health and Google Health Connect
Provides extensive methods for handling health data, workouts, and routes
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup and specific permissions in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml
Android target phone needs the Health Connect app installed
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions and HealthKit capabilities in Xcode for iOS, and specific queries, permissions, and extending FlutterFragmentActivity for Android.
